mutations.name: a Morning line or task blocks when its lens says blocking
kills: sources that never block lists a Morning line and an active-work task as planning even when asked as blocking

mutations.name: a gate blocks though its run waits on another gate
kills: a hitl gate in the inbox is planning when its live run waits on another gate

mutations.name: a gate on a closed PR blocks
kills: a hitl gate in the inbox is planning when its PR is closed and Shepherd holds no live row for it

mutations.name: each question of a round keeps its own row
kills: a multi-question round in the inbox is one blocking row carrying its question count and no per-question options

mutations.name: a close-pr op blocks while its asker is live
kills: a deposit or chat ask in the inbox blocks on a merge op only at the live run's head, and never for a cleanup op
